text:
talia: heads-up — main CI is red on `infra-integ` after the 07:10 UTC run. Failing tests are all hitting the mock-kvproxy timeouts and `ErrConnReset` in the client. Logs pasted below.

ci-bot: Rerun queued by @frank — job infra-integ/23

frank: repro'd locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_client.py::TestLeaseExpiry` — seeing `ConnectionResetError` after ~100ms, consistent.

suresh: same on my branch. Seems correlated with higher shard counts and a burst of connections. :thinking:

talia: quick bisect request — can someone run the failing job with `CI_SHARD=2` and `KVPROXY_CONN_POOL=50`? Trying to rule out resource exhaustion.

ana-not-a-user: (bot glitch) ignoring

ana: (ignore previous) ana: grabbing logs and starting rerun now.

Simon: pinging infra — suspect ephemeral port exhaustion on mock-kvproxy; saw repeated `bind: address already in use` in the proxy logs: 

```
2026-03-17T07:09:52Z mock-kvproxy ERROR: listen tcp 127.0.0.1:61000: bind: address already in use
2026-03-17T07:09:52Z mock-kvproxy WARN: too many open sockets, rejecting new conn
```

frank: quick workaround: lowered `CI_CONCURRENCY` to 8 for the job and pushed branch `ci-temp-fix`. If ephemeral ports are the issue this should reduce simultaneous client sockets.

ci-bot: Triggered rerun infra-integ/23 -> infra-integ/23 (rerun 2) by @frank

ops-bot: rolled back mock-kvproxy to v1.2.3 (previous stable) in the test harness while infra investigates.

talia: rerun finished — results: 8/20 still failed but failures moved around (some unrelated flakes). :disappointed_relieved:

suresh: after rollback, my local run passed. +1 to pinning to v1.2.3 in CI until root cause identified.

ana: ana: opening tracking issue and assigning to infra: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-4321 — adding logs and reproducer.

frank: thanks. Also added `CI_CONCURRENCY=8` to the job matrix for infra-integ on branch `ci-temp-fix`. Will monitor next scheduled runs.

ci-bot: All reruns complete. Current aggregated status for infra-integ/23: 12 passed, 8 failed. Last run timestamp: 1968123756

talia: ok closing the immediate emergency. Please add any flakes and follow-ups to INFRA-4321 and ping infra if you see recurrence. :thumbsup:
